scientific_integrity: All-k proof is elementary symbolic Hilbert space decomposition and exact quadratic integrals; finite exact calculations are supplementary; priority over possible unindexed equivalent literature is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Exact leaf and hub evaluation norms only, not a claim about the global L-infinity operator norm; equilateral metric stars, unit edge density, and edgewise continuous quadratic polynomials with only value matching at the hub.
title: Exact leaf sensitivity and positivity loss for quadratic least-squares splines on a metric star
